title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_le_cure_d_ars_by_mgr_guy_bagnard_2up7m (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_le_cure_d_ars_by_mgr_guy_bagnard_2up7m' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package results in full system compromise, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to the extent of control granted to the attacker, complete remediation cannot be guaranteed without additional measures such as rotating all secrets from a different, uncompromised system.
